leadText: Pikachu the Movie Memorial (ピカチュウ･ザ･ムービーメモリアル) is a segment exclusive to the Japanese version of Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl that appeared from DP075—DP084, temporarily replacing Professor Oak's Big Pokémon Encyclopedia. It describes the powers and abilities of each Pokémon protagonist of the first ten .
plainText:
Pikachu the Movie Memorial (ピカチュウ･ザ･ムービーメモリアル) is a segment exclusive to the Japanese version of Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl that appeared from DP075—DP084, temporarily replacing Professor Oak's Big Pokémon Encyclopedia. It describes the powers and abilities of each Pokémon protagonist of the first ten .

==List of segments==
 

==Trivia==
Talking about Mewtwo, Professor Oak says, "There is only one of this Pokémon in the entire world." However, this was later contradicted.
